m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>You pass through the portal and find yourself in a place unlike any you've seen before. Sand stretches to the horizon in all directions. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>Qismah said the World Door would be close, but possibly buried in the sand. You'll have to search for it. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>A Wanderer appears in the desert... from another time and another world, but with purpose. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You seek to restore the World Door. It is close, but you must discover the Secret of the Sands to reach it. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>The Sands hide many secrets, but sometimes, they can reveal them as well. Collect Sand Grains from the Sand Swirlers and return. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>Well done, Wanderer. Now cast the Sand Grains into the chasm and see what is revealed. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You cast the Sand Grains into the Chasm and a bridge is revealed that will take you across. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You sense that the World Door is buried somewhere amid the dunes on the other side, but you aren't sure exactly where. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>As you reach the top of the dune, you finally see the World Door, partially submerged in the sand. Only problem is, it's guarded by a Djinni. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>With the Djinni defeated, you can now approach and use Qismah's charm to restore the World Door. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>If the Charm worked correctly, the World Door should now be restored to its proper time and place. You can use the Portal to return to Qismah. </ITALICS>
You were gone some time. I trust you found the Door and the Charm worked as expected? Excellent. Now you can travel to Mirage the proper way.
You must understand - Mirage is a world of constant change, ever-shifting Sands. But the last few years have seen a rash of massive sand storms.
More recently, there was a sand storm of colossal proportions. During the storm, somehow, the World Door in Mirage was lost in the Sands.
You see, the Sands of Mirage are unique. They're more than elements in a desert landscape. They are - quite literally - the Sands of Time.
Thus the World Door is lost, not just in space, but in time as well. I believe, however, I've devised a way to reach it and to restore it.
I have not yet pinpointed its exact location in the space-time continuum, but this portal can at least get you in the vicinity.
Take the portal, find the lost World Door where it is buried, and use this charm to restore it to its proper time and place. Then return.
Good luck, Initiate. After you've used the charm to restore the World Door, return through the portal and we will discuss next steps.
